expected_function_roles.apply_gain: Scales a signed value by an integer percentage.
expected_function_roles.clamp_output: Clamps a signed control value to the inclusive range zero through one thousand.
expected_function_roles.control_output: Runs normalization, gain, and clamping as a multi-function control pipeline.
expected_function_roles.main: Runs embedded behavior self-tests and returns zero only when all pass.
expected_function_roles.normalize_sensor: Subtracts a calibration offset from a raw sensor value.
expected_function_roles.sample_probe: Passes all three probe inputs to the control pipeline.
